name: vector_search
description: Semantic recall over facts. Embeds query_text and returns the nearest fact subjects for the caller's tenant, each with its current value and status. Tenant-scoped; no free-form SQL.

tenant_id.description: Tenant to search within (requested data scope). The Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it.

query_text.description: Natural-language text to embed and match against subject embeddings.

top_k.description: Number of nearest subjects to return, intended range 1..50 (default 10). Upper bound still capped at 50 server-side; DEGRADATION: the Gateway no longer enforces the lower bound >=1.
